projection.purpose: Project orders without moving payment authority.

contract.input: Authenticated synthetic order events with durable event identity.
contract.authority: The commerce provider owns payment and entitlement decisions.
contract.step: Deduplicate events and keep one fixed row owner per order.
Use a durable export outbox; retries preserve identity and provenance.
Import only approved release artifacts with source and content hashes.
contract.reject: Refuse unsigned, conflicting or unapproved inputs.

test.given: A spreadsheet export fails after accepting an event.
test.then: Export the same order projection without another payment or duplicate row.
